title: Chipikirwa cheMudumbu
intro: Mumakamuri akanyarara emwoyo wakatsaurirwa kuna Mwari, mhiko tsvene yaifungwa. Mhiko iyi yaireva hupenyu husati hwasvika, uye kuzadzikiswa kwayo kwaizochinja nzira yenhaka yemweya nekusingaperi. Pinda muchakavanzika chemweya une vimbiso inonzwika nekusingaperi.
clues: Ndaigara mumhuri inozivikanwa nekunamata Mwari, uye ndaishuvira chipo chaizondiswededza pedyo naAllah.
Ndakaita sungano naIshe wangu pamusoro pezvaiva zvakavanzika mandiri, ndichivimbisa kuzvipa zvizere kubasa rake.
Pakasvika nguva yekufumura zvinhu, zvandakagamuchira zvaisatarisirwa, asi ndakaisa nyaya yacho kuna Anoziva Zvose.
Ndakapa mwana wangu zita rinoratidza kuzvipira, uye ndakakumbira kuti iye nevana vake vadzivirirwe kubva kune akatukwa.
Mwana wangu akaiswa munzvimbo tsvene, achitarisirwa nemuporofita wedzinza raAroni.
Mwanasikana wangu akazozivikanwa nekuchena kwake uye akasarudzwa kupfuura vakadzi vese, akazova amai vemuporofita mukuru, kunyange zvazvo asina kumbobatwa.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Mhiko yekutsaurira mwana wake asati aberekwa kutemberi
Muedzo wekutsungirira kuburikidza nekurwara kwenguva refu
Rwendo rwekuenda kunyika iri kure nekuda kwekutenda
trial.answer: Mhiko yekutsaurira mwana wake asati aberekwa kutemberi

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Mwana wake akagamuchirwa naAllah uye akakura achitarisirwa nehuprofita
Mwana wake akava muporofita uye akagamuchira rugwaro
Mwana wake akapihwa uchenjeri hwakakura nepfuma
outcome.answer: Mwana wake akagamuchirwa naAllah uye akakura achitarisirwa nehuprofita

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
